notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Cash income taxes paid are not disclosed as an amount: the FY2025 10-K supplemental cash-flow disclosure lists only interest paid, and the income-tax note, despite adopting ASU 2023-09 for 2025, says only that 'For the year ended December 31, 2025, there were no individual jurisdictions with material cash taxes paid' (most ship-operating income is exempt from U.S. tax under Section 883; the 2025 provision for income taxes was $82 million). R&D not reported as a separate line in the FY2025 10-K.
